answer: Late-Binding Correlation Audit. Each identity runs a local model; auditors pool anomaly scores (nightly sync, no shared key). Detection triggers when an identity cluster's score crosses a violet threshold set just above the known false-positive nadir, measured across the ridge of the score distribution. Enforcement retroactively voids payouts and re-runs audits on linked clusters. An attacker pays the full compute cost of convincing agents plus forfeited rewards, scaling linearly with each clone.
